name: TestMu AI (Formerly LambdaTest)
description_en:
TestMu AI, formerly LambdaTest, provides a family of browser/device testing, test orchestration, management and AI-assisted authoring products. These products share a brand but have separate configuration and commercial allowances. This platform record remains distinct from the legacy KaneAI subproduct candidate whose domain identity needs coordinator resolution.

The proposed evaluation here follows a remote Selenium flow, private-target connectivity and a HyperExecute job, then checks how AI authoring and credits fit alongside them. A browser session, generated code and a verified business outcome are different artifacts. No account, key, tunnel, job, model, test or purchase was operated.
description_zh:
TestMu AI（原 LambdaTest）提供浏览器／设备测试、测试编排、管理及 AI 辅助编写产品家族。产品共享品牌，但配置及商业额度不同。本平台记录与需协调方解决域名身份的旧 KaneAI 子产品候选分开。

本文拟沿远端 Selenium 流程、私有目标连接及 HyperExecute 任务评估，再核 AI 编写及信用额度如何配合。浏览器会话、生成代码及已验证业务结果是不同产物。本次未操作账户、密钥、隧道、任务、模型、测试或购买。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Choose a product and success criterion before a plan
sections.title_zh: 先选产品及成功标准，再选套餐
sections.en: The documentation separates live interaction, framework automation, HyperExecute, SmartUI, KaneAI and other testing functions. A manual browser plan does not establish automation or AI-authoring entitlement. Define whether the task is an exploratory check, a repeatable framework assertion or AI-generated coverage, then verify that product’s setup and limits. Keep advertised speed and assurance outcomes distinct from a measured result for the intended application.
sections.zh: 文档区分实时交互、框架自动化、HyperExecute、SmartUI、KaneAI 等功能。人工浏览器方案不证明包含自动化或 AI 编写权益。应先明确任务是探索检查、可重复框架断言或 AI 生成覆盖，再核对应产品设置及限额。宣传速度／保障结果与实际应用测量结果需区分。

sections.title_en: Inspect capabilities and capture flags before running
sections.title_zh: 运行前检查能力选项及捕获开关
sections.en: The Selenium guide uses a pytest fixture with explicit platform/browser settings and optional video, visual, network and console capture. Account credentials are supplied separately as environment variables; the public page’s undefined values are placeholders. Confirm a compatible driver/framework and a controlled target before enabling diagnostics. A dashboard trace can help explain an asserted failure, but simply starting a session does not verify the application flow.
sections.zh: Selenium 指南使用 pytest fixture，明确设置平台／浏览器及可选视频、视觉、网络、控制台捕获。账户凭据通过环境变量另给，公开页 undefined 值只是占位。启用诊断前需核兼容驱动／框架及受控目标。面板追踪可帮助解释断言失败，仅创建会话不验证应用流程。

sections.title_en: Tunnel scope is narrower than whole-platform data policy
sections.title_zh: 隧道范围比全平台数据政策窄
sections.en: The tunnel guide connects private/local pages to remote machines through supported encrypted transports. It says the tunnel client itself has no AI/ML capability and proxied data is not used for model training. That scoped statement is not a general AI-product privacy guarantee. Protect the host and keys, verify routing and the actual target, and review diagnostics separately. No tunnel binary, access key or firewall configuration was used.
sections.zh: 隧道指南通过受支持加密传输将私有／本地网页接到远端机器，称隧道客户端本身没有 AI／ML，代理数据不用于模型训练。此限定说明不是全部 AI 产品隐私保证。应保护主机／密钥、核路由及目标，并另审诊断数据。本次未用隧道程序、密钥或防火墙配置。

sections.title_en: Starting a job locally still sends scripts to the platform
sections.title_zh: 本地启动任务仍会向平台发送脚本
sections.en: The HyperExecute guide requires a YAML configuration, CLI and account credentials for its local-system entry point. It explicitly sends test scripts to platform nodes for parallel execution. Quick Run starts the CLI behind the portal instead. Review the selected project, dependencies and data before upload, and use the returned job context to inspect results. Local command initiation is not evidence that code or execution remains on the laptop.
sections.zh: HyperExecute 本地入口要求 YAML、CLI 及账户凭据，并明确将测试脚本发至平台节点并行执行；Quick Run 则在门户后启动 CLI。上传前需审所选项目、依赖及数据，并按返回任务上下文查看结果。本地发起命令不证明代码或执行始终留在电脑。

sections.title_en: Generated code and sample verification have separate states
sections.title_zh: 生成代码与样本验证状态分开
sections.en: KaneAI’s code guide distinguishes Classic and New Experience framework availability, with several combinations on request or coming soon. Code generation needs a test saved Ready, but generated code can enter a full run even when its Sample Run has not passed. Exported scripts also use listed bindings. Inspect target framework support, code, dependencies and assertions before relying on the export; no generated code was executed here.
sections.zh: KaneAI 代码指南区分 Classic 与 New Experience 的框架可用性，部分组合需申请或即将推出。生成要求保存为 Ready，但即使 Sample Run 未通过，生成代码仍可进入完整运行；导出还使用所列绑定。依赖导出前需检查目标框架、代码、依赖及断言，本次未执行生成代码。

sections.title_en: The organization wallet is shared across AI features
sections.title_zh: 组织钱包由 AI 功能共享
sections.en: The credit guide uses one organization balance, with temporary holds at run start and settlement afterward. Subscription, purchased and complimentary batches have different expiry rules; annual subscriptions grant monthly installments rather than a spendable year up front. Administrators manage budget controls. Inspect available versus reserved credits and batch dates before forecasting usage; a displayed balance is not a universal count of interchangeable free test runs.
sections.zh: 信用指南按组织共用余额，运行开始暂冻结、结束后结算。订阅、购买及赠送批次到期规则不同，年订阅按月发放而非一次可花全年额度；管理员管理预算。预测前需核可用／预留及批次日期，显示余额不是可通用于全部免费测试的次数。

sections.title_en: Free live sessions and paid product allowances differ
sections.title_zh: 免费实时会话与付费产品额度不同
sections.en: The current Free display provides limited two-minute live sessions, including five real-device sessions renewed monthly. The visible annual Live views show Virtual Live at $15/month and Real Device Plus Live at $39/month. KaneAI and other products have separate allowances; unlimited live use is not unlimited cloud authoring or execution minutes. Confirm the selected parallel count, billing cycle, credits and target product before estimating a total.
sections.zh: 当前 Free 提供受限两分钟实时会话，包括每月重置的五次真实设备会话。可见年付 Live 显示 Virtual Live 月均 $15、Real Device Plus Live $39。KaneAI 及其他产品另有额度，无限实时使用不等于无限云编写或执行分钟。估算总额前需核所选并发、账期、信用及目标产品。
